iti25:1.1: (Ek. III.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti25:2.1: Ekadhammaṃ atītassa bhikkhave purisapuggalassa nāhaṃ tassa kiñci pāpakammaṃ akaraṇīyan-ti vadāmi. Katamaṃ ekadhammaṃ? Yathayidaṃ bhikkhave sampajānamusāvādo ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti25:3.1: Ekadhammaṃ atītassa musāvādissa jantuno | vitiṇṇaparalokassa natthi pāpaṃ akāriyan-ti ||
iti25:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||5||
